description: Threads (Meta) post search: the top posts for a keyword or hashtag as the logged-out search page shows them (usually 3 to 10) with author, text, time, likes, replies, reposts, quotes, media and link. From threads.net through a residential proxy; Threads decides the ranking and there is no date filter. Some topics (for example body image or health) show no posts to logged-out visitors at all; then the answer says so with resultStatus no_matches. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_threads_replies when you need Replies to a Threads post: the post itself and the replies; social_threads_profile when you need Threads profile: name, verified flag, bio, follower count. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
